title: Forms Technology And Generate Mode
description: Introduce forms technology (declarative form data, question kinds, multi-step builder playground) and flow Generate mode where input widgets become forms and generations are saved submissions evaluated through the worker pipeline. Extend ui with Catalogue, cross-container tree reorder, and Field primitives.
summary: Fixed forms dev playground not loading the Building Component example. Root causes: setActiveExample read fixtureId while navbar sends exampleId; Vite glob can be empty so FORMS_PLAY_FILE_EXAMPLE_JSON_BY_ID had no entries; createRuntime never bootstrapped the default example; getExampleCatalog active id did not match catalog option ids (building-component vs forms-building-component). Added static fallback import for building-component.forms.json, fixed setActiveExample to use exampleId, map catalog active id correctly, and load default example in createRuntime (matching draw play). All 27 forms-core tests pass.
